notes_20240423115229.simpleHindiExplanation: कमल के कीचड़ में खिलने की छवि से सीख दी गई है कि बुरे आचरण वाले लोगों के बीच रहकर भी व्यक्ति अपना चरित्र और अच्छाई बनाए रख सकता है।
notes_20240423115229.context: Dated 2023-02-22 with “कमल/जलज” as the prompt, the poem turns the lotus-in-mud image into moral advice. “कीच जनों” is figurative and disparaging; it refers to conduct rather than literal dirt.

literalEnglish: Do not take a plain and simple statement to mean something else.
Let go of suspicion from the mind, and life will be blessed.
notes_20240423115234.childFriendlyEnglish: Clear words should not be twisted into hidden meanings. Setting aside needless suspicion can make relationships calmer.
notes_20240423115234.simpleHindiExplanation: सीधी बात का गलत या छिपा अर्थ न निकालने की सलाह है। अनावश्यक शंका छोड़ने से मन और संबंध दोनों अधिक शांत रह सकते हैं।
notes_20240423115234.context: Dated 2023-02-22 with “मतलब” as the prompt, this is general advice about interpretation and suspicion. The source does not identify a particular conversation or misunderstanding.

literalEnglish: Taking the sun to be a fruit, Hanuman swallowed it.
When darkness spread, the people were astonished.
notes_20240423115238.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem retells the playful childhood story in which Hanuman mistakes the glowing sun for a fruit, leaving the world amazed when darkness follows.
notes_20240423115238.simpleHindiExplanation: बाल हनुमान के सूर्य को फल समझकर निगल लेने वाली पौराणिक कथा का वर्णन है। सूर्य छिपने से अंधकार फैलता है और लोग चकित हो जाते हैं।
notes_20240423115238.context: Dated 2023-02-23 with “फल” as the prompt, the verse recounts a well-known episode from Hanuman traditions. It is mythological narrative, not an astronomical claim.

literalEnglish: Set aside concern for the result and keep performing your duty.
In the Gita, Shri Krishna taught this very principle.
notes_20240423115243.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem says to focus on doing the right work instead of worrying only about rewards, drawing its lesson from Krishna's teaching in the Gita.
notes_20240423115243.simpleHindiExplanation: फल की चिंता छोड़कर अपना कर्म करते रहने की सीख दी गई है। इसे गीता में श्रीकृष्ण के निष्काम कर्म के संदेश से जोड़ा गया है।
notes_20240423115243.context: Dated 2023-02-23 with “फल” as the prompt, the verse paraphrases the Bhagavad Gita's teaching about action without attachment to results. It is a concise devotional interpretation rather than a direct quotation.

literalEnglish: Blessed, blessed is this country, which holds the four sacred pilgrimage abodes.
It has the twelve Jyotirlingas, and Shri Rama dwells in Awadh.
notes_20240423115247.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem celebrates India's sacred geography through the four dhams, the twelve Jyotirlingas, and Rama's association with Awadh.
notes_20240423115247.simpleHindiExplanation: भारत की धार्मिक विरासत का गौरवगान है। चार धाम, बारह ज्योतिर्लिंग और अवध में श्रीराम की उपस्थिति को देश की पवित्रता के प्रतीक के रूप में रखा गया है।
notes_20240423115247.context: Dated 2023-02-28 with “धन्य” as the prompt, the poem names major Hindu pilgrimage traditions and Rama's connection with Awadh. The English retains “धाम” because it denotes sacred pilgrimage abodes, not merely ordinary places.

literalEnglish: Nothing is difficult for the one upon whom the Divine bestows grace.
Hearing the elephant's anguished cry, the compassionate Lord rushed to help.
notes_20240423115252.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem uses the story of an elephant rescued by God to express faith that sincere cries for help are heard even in great danger.
notes_20240423115252.simpleHindiExplanation: ईश्वर की कृपा से कठिन मार्ग भी पार होने का विश्वास व्यक्त किया गया है। हाथी की करुण पुकार पर भगवान के दौड़े आने का संकेत गजेन्द्र-मोक्ष की कथा से जुड़ता है।
notes_20240423115252.context: Dated 2023-03-01 with “दुर्गम” as the prompt, the elephant's plea appears to evoke the Gajendra Moksha narrative. The source does not name Gajendra explicitly, so that identification remains a strong but editorial inference.

literalEnglish: Make a timetable according to what is practical for you.
Work will happen at the right time, and time will not be wasted.
notes_20240423115256.childFriendlyEnglish: A realistic schedule helps people finish tasks when needed and use their time well.
notes_20240423115256.simpleHindiExplanation: अपनी सुविधा और दिनचर्या के अनुसार समय-सारणी बनाने की सलाह है। सही योजना से काम समय पर पूरा होता है और समय व्यर्थ नहीं जाता।
notes_20240423115256.context: Dated 2023-03-01 with “सुविधा” as the prompt, the verse gives practical time-management advice. No particular occupation, school schedule, or deadline is specified.

literalEnglish: Rangbhari Ekadashi falls in the month of Phagun.
Devotees of Vishnu and Shiva are filled with enthusiasm.
notes_20240423115303.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem celebrates Rangbhari Ekadashi as a joyful Phagun observance that inspires devotion to Vishnu and Shiva.
notes_20240423115303.simpleHindiExplanation: फागुन में आने वाली रंगभरी एकादशी के उत्साह का वर्णन है। रचना इस अवसर को विष्णु और शिव—दोनों के भक्तों की उमंग से जोड़ती है।
notes_20240423115303.context: The catalog date is 2023-03-01, while the मंच date is 2023-03-02, and the prompt is “एकादशी.” Rangbhari Ekadashi is especially associated with festive Shiva traditions in Varanasi, while Ekadashi more broadly is associated with Vishnu; the poem itself explicitly names both devotional communities.

literalEnglish: Listen, beautiful-eyed one: without you, this world is empty.
When you are near, the world seems filled with spring.
notes_20240423115331.childFriendlyEnglish: The speaker tells a beloved person that their presence makes the whole world feel bright, lively, and full of spring.
notes_20240423115331.simpleHindiExplanation: प्रिय को “सुनयने” कहकर संबोधित किया गया है। उसके बिना संसार सूना लगता है और उसके पास होने पर जीवन में बहार का अनुभव होता है।
notes_20240423115331.context: Dated 2023-03-04 with “सुनयने” as the prompt, the verse is affectionate and uses spring as a metaphor for joy. The beloved's identity and the real-life occasion, if any, are not given.

literalEnglish: Friend, I will play Holi in the company of my beloved Shyam.
The colour that dyes the inner self is the true colour.
notes_20240423115336.childFriendlyEnglish: Playing Holi with Krishna becomes a picture of devotion: the deepest colour is the love that changes the heart from within.
notes_20240423115336.simpleHindiExplanation: श्याम प्रिय के साथ होली खेलने की इच्छा भक्तिभाव से जुड़ी है। बाहरी रंग से अधिक महत्त्व उस प्रेम और भक्ति के रंग का है जो मन को भीतर तक रंग दे।
notes_20240423115336.context: Dated 2023-03-04 with “रंग” as the prompt, the poem uses Holi and “Shyam” in Krishna-devotional imagery. It moves from festival colour to an inward spiritual metaphor.

literalEnglish: People are astonished on seeing the sweeping view.
An eagle flew through the sky carrying a fish.
notes_20240423115341.childFriendlyEnglish: The sight of a large bird flying overhead with a fish creates a dramatic nature scene that surprises onlookers.
notes_20240423115341.simpleHindiExplanation: आकाश में मछली लेकर उड़ते बाज का दृश्य लोगों को चकित करता है। “विहंगम” यहाँ विशाल या दूर तक फैले दृश्य का भाव देता है।
notes_20240423115341.context: The catalog date is 2023-03-05, while the मंच date is 2023-03-04, with “विहंगम” as the prompt. “बाज” may refer broadly to a hawk, eagle, or similar raptor; the exact species is not identifiable from the poem.

literalEnglish: By killing Hiranyakashipu, the cause of truth was upheld.
Prahlad was protected, and Holika was burned.
notes_20240423115345.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem recalls Prahlad's rescue and the defeat of those who tried to harm him, presenting the story as a victory of truth and faith.
notes_20240423115345.simpleHindiExplanation: प्रह्लाद की रक्षा, हिरण्यकशिपु के वध और होलिका-दहन की पौराणिक कथा के माध्यम से सत्य और भक्ति की विजय दिखाई गई है।
notes_20240423115345.context: Dated 2023-03-05 with “सत्य” as the prompt, the verse combines connected episodes from the Prahlad narrative. The compact wording does not distinguish the separate roles of Narasimha in Hiranyakashipu's death and the fire in Holika's death.

literalEnglish: Listen, beautiful-eyed one: without you, this world is empty.
When you are near, the world seems filled with spring.
notes_20240423115349.childFriendlyEnglish: Addressing a dear person as “beautiful-eyed,” the speaker says that closeness to them turns loneliness into a season of happiness.
notes_20240423115349.simpleHindiExplanation: “सुनयने” नाम से पुकारे गए प्रिय के दूर होने पर संसार सूना लगता है। उसके पास आते ही मन को ऐसा आनंद मिलता है मानो चारों ओर बसंत छा गया हो।
notes_20240423115349.context: The catalog date is 2023-03-05, while the मंच date is 2023-03-04, and the text duplicates the wording of notes_20240423115331. The preserved records are separate exports, so this draft describes this record without guessing why the same verse appears twice.

literalEnglish: Salutations to the Doha Creators Forum.
Day: Sunday.
Keep peace in the mind, and hold no needless entanglement.
Victory belongs to the one who does not lose courage.
That person will cross over and find the shore.
With the oar in hand, become your own boatman.
Submitted respectfully for review.
notes_20240423115353.childFriendlyEnglish: Calm thinking, courage, and self-reliance can help a person steer through difficulty and reach safety.
notes_20240423115353.simpleHindiExplanation: मन को शांत रखकर उलझनों से बचने, साहस न खोने और अपनी राह स्वयं सँभालने की प्रेरणा है। नाव, पतवार और किनारे की छवियाँ कठिनाई पार करने के रूपक हैं।
notes_20240423115353.context: Dated 2023-03-05 and identified as रोला छंद, the poem uses crossing water as a metaphor for overcoming difficulty. No literal voyage or named challenge is indicated.

literalEnglish: Do not turn meaning into misinterpretation, and do not oppose without cause.
Sacred texts and Puranas deserve research before judgment.
notes_20240423115357.childFriendlyEnglish: Before arguing about religious writings, the poem asks readers to study them carefully and avoid distorting their meaning.
notes_20240423115357.simpleHindiExplanation: ग्रंथों और पुराणों का विरोध करने या उनका गलत अर्थ निकालने से पहले अध्ययन और शोध करने की सलाह दी गई है। संदेश है कि मत बनाने से पहले विषय को समझना चाहिए।
notes_20240423115357.context: The मंच date is 2023-03-06, while the catalog date is 2023-03-05, with “विरोध” as the prompt. The compressed phrase “अर्थ, अनर्थ नहीं करो” is read as a warning against distorting meaning; other nuances are possible.

literalEnglish: How can those who have themselves strayed from the path show the way?
In today's politics, there is only a desire for power.
notes_20240423115402.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem questions whether leaders who have lost their own moral direction can guide others, and criticizes politics focused only on gaining power.
notes_20240423115402.simpleHindiExplanation: जो स्वयं सही मार्ग से भटक गए हों, वे दूसरों को राह कैसे दिखाएँगे—यह प्रश्न उठाया गया है। दोहा आज की राजनीति में सेवा के बजाय सत्ता-लालसा पर व्यंग्य करता है।
notes_20240423115402.context: Dated 2023-03-09 with “पथ” as the prompt, the verse is a general political criticism. It names no party, leader, election, or specific misconduct.

literalEnglish: The clock is telling you: keep moving, respected friend.
If you stop without reason, the destination will remain far away.
notes_20240423115405.childFriendlyEnglish: Time keeps moving, so steady effort is needed to bring a goal closer.
notes_20240423115405.simpleHindiExplanation: घड़ी के माध्यम से लगातार आगे बढ़ते रहने की सीख दी गई है। बिना कारण रुक जाने पर लक्ष्य दूर रह जाता है।
notes_20240423115405.context: Dated 2023-03-09 with “पल/घड़ी” as the prompt, the clock is personified as offering motivational advice. The destination is metaphorical and not tied to a stated journey.

literalEnglish: Dashrath Manjhi is a determined figure of the nation.
Cutting through the mountain's chest, he made his way across.
notes_20240423115415.childFriendlyEnglish: Dashrath Manjhi's long effort to cut a path through a mountain becomes an example of extraordinary determination.
notes_20240423115415.simpleHindiExplanation: दशरथ मांझी के पहाड़ काटकर रास्ता बनाने वाले संकल्प को दृढ़ चरित्र का उदाहरण बताया गया है। “पहाड़ का सीना चीरना” उनके कठिन श्रम की काव्यात्मक छवि है।
notes_20240423115415.context: Dated 2023-03-09 with “किरदार” as the prompt, the verse refers to Dashrath Manjhi, widely remembered for carving a road through a hill in Bihar. The line is celebratory and compresses many years of labour into one image.

literalEnglish: Until now, Dangal had ruled at number one.
But through “Besharam Rang,” Pathaan now wears the crown.
notes_20240423115422.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem comments on a change in Hindi-film box-office rankings, saying that Pathaan overtook Dangal while referring to Pathaan's song “Besharam Rang.”
notes_20240423115422.simpleHindiExplanation: यह दोहा हिंदी फिल्मों की कमाई या लोकप्रियता की रैंकिंग पर टिप्पणी करता है। इसमें कहा गया है कि पहले “दंगल” शीर्ष पर थी, पर “पठान” ने “बेशरम रंग” के साथ नया स्थान बना लिया।
notes_20240423115422.context: Dated 2023-03-11 with “दंगल” as the prompt, the wording appears to refer to contemporary reports that the film Pathaan surpassed a box-office record associated with Dangal. “Besharam Rang” is a song from Pathaan, but the exact market, gross measure, or ranking intended is not specified.

literalEnglish: Share in sorrow, and the sorrow becomes half as heavy.
Share happiness together, and the joy becomes twice as great.
notes_20240423115508.childFriendlyEnglish: Supporting one another makes hard times easier, while celebrating together makes good moments feel even happier.
notes_20240423115508.simpleHindiExplanation: दुख में साथ देने से पीड़ा हल्की लगती है और खुशियाँ बाँटने से आनंद बढ़ता है। दोहा सहानुभूति और मिल-जुलकर जीने का सरल संदेश देता है।
notes_20240423115508.context: The catalog date is 2023-03-11, while the मंच date is 2023-03-12, with “खुशियां” as the prompt. Halving sorrow and doubling happiness are familiar metaphors, not numerical claims.

literalEnglish: Session.
Parliament runs in three sessions: the Budget session passes by,
then the Monsoon session begins, while Winter is the shortest of all.
notes_20240423115512.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem briefly names Parliament's Budget, Monsoon, and Winter sessions and notes that the Winter session is the shortest.
notes_20240423115512.simpleHindiExplanation: संसद के तीन प्रमुख सत्र—बजट, मानसून और शीतकालीन—गिनाए गए हैं। रचना के अनुसार इनमें शीतकालीन सत्र सबसे छोटा होता है।
notes_20240423115512.context: Dated 2023-03-13 with “सत्र” as the prompt, the verse summarizes the conventional names of the Indian Parliament's three annual sessions. Session lengths vary by year, so “Winter is shortest” is a broad observation rather than a fixed constitutional rule.

literalEnglish: India's stature grew by receiving an Oscar honour.
“Naatu Naatu” has now become an emblem of India's identity.
notes_20240423115516.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem celebrates the Oscar won by “Naatu Naatu” and the international pride surrounding the Indian song.
notes_20240423115516.simpleHindiExplanation: “नाटु नाटु” को ऑस्कर मिलने पर भारत की प्रतिष्ठा और सांस्कृतिक पहचान बढ़ने का उत्सव मनाया गया है।
notes_20240423115516.context: The catalog date is 2023-03-14 and the मंच date is 2023-03-15, immediately after “Naatu Naatu” from RRR won the 2023 Academy Award for Best Original Song. Calling it India's identity is celebratory national-pride language, not an exclusive definition of Indian culture.

literalEnglish: Kundaliya competition: 57.
Topic: “Summer.”
Summer has special fruits: cucumber, long cucumber, and mango.
Muskmelon and watermelon work to provide coolness.
To provide coolness, prepare a drink from raw mango.
Mix lemon and sugar, and serve plenty of shikanji.
When the month of Jeth begins, falsa berries bring relief.
As Dussehri and Safeda mangoes ripen, they answer the summer heat.
notes_20240423115526.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem welcomes summer with cooling fruits and drinks, from watermelon and cucumber to raw-mango panna, lemonade, falsa, and ripe mangoes.
notes_20240423115526.simpleHindiExplanation: गर्मी में मिलने वाले फल और ठंडक देने वाले पेय गिनाए गए हैं। खीरा, ककड़ी, खरबूजा, तरबूज, आम का पना, शिकंजी, फालसा और अलग-अलग आम गर्म मौसम में स्वाद और राहत देते हैं।
notes_20240423115526.context: Dated 2023-03-15 and written for a कुंडलिया competition on “गर्मी,” the poem lists North Indian seasonal foods. “सफेदा खाये गर्मी” is compact and playful; the translation reads it as Safeda mango helping people face the heat, not as a medical claim.

literalEnglish: Recognize Tulsidas, Surdas, and Kabir, if you truly can.
All were great learned souls who shared wisdom with the world.
notes_20240423115559.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem honours Tulsidas, Surdas, and Kabir as major poet-saints whose writings taught generations of readers.
notes_20240423115559.simpleHindiExplanation: तुलसीदास, सूरदास और कबीर को महान ज्ञानी कवि-संत मानकर उनके संसार को दिए ज्ञान का सम्मान किया गया है।
notes_20240423115559.context: Dated 2023-03-16 with “ज्ञानी” as the prompt, the verse groups three major figures of North Indian devotional literature. “जान सके तो जान” is an emphatic invitation to recognize their stature.

literalEnglish: The sun gives light; what selfish purpose does it have?
The fruits of trees, too, always serve the good of others.
notes_20240423115604.childFriendlyEnglish: The sun and fruit trees give without asking for a reward, offering examples of generosity and service.
notes_20240423115604.simpleHindiExplanation: सूरज की रोशनी और वृक्षों के फल को निःस्वार्थ परोपकार के उदाहरण बनाया गया है। संदेश है कि दूसरों के हित में देना श्रेष्ठ गुण है।
notes_20240423115604.context: Dated 2023-03-16 with “स्वार्थ” as the prompt, the poem personifies natural processes as selfless giving. It is a moral analogy, not a scientific account of intention in the sun or trees.

literalEnglish: Health is more important than anything; do not keep the mind weary.
Quickly calm the resentment and turmoil gathered in the heart.
notes_20240423115607.childFriendlyEnglish: For the sake of health, the poem advises releasing pent-up anger and calming a tired, troubled mind.
notes_20240423115607.simpleHindiExplanation: सेहत को सबसे बड़ा धन मानते हुए मन की थकान, क्रोध और दबे हुए गुबार को शांत करने की सलाह दी गई है।
notes_20240423115607.context: The record is cataloged on 2023-03-16 but gives 2023-03-14 as the मंच date, with “गुबार” as the prompt. “गुबार” can mean pent-up resentment, emotional pressure, or turmoil; the exact feeling is not specified.

literalEnglish: Read the Durga Saptashati, and may every crisis move away.
Through its auspicious recitation, enemies are crushed.
notes_20240423115611.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem expresses faith in reciting the Durga Saptashati for courage and protection during trouble.
notes_20240423115611.simpleHindiExplanation: दुर्गा सप्तशती के मंगल पाठ को संकटों से रक्षा और विरोधी शक्तियों पर विजय देने वाला माना गया है। यह भक्तिपूर्ण विश्वास की अभिव्यक्ति है।
notes_20240423115611.context: Dated 2023-03-17 with “पाठ” as the prompt, the verse presents a devotional belief about reciting the Durga Saptashati. “Enemies are crushed” is forceful religious imagery; the source does not identify literal enemies or advocate a specific action against anyone.

literalEnglish: Friend, when defeat stands before you, keep trying.
Do not abandon your effort; defeat will turn into victory.
notes_20240423115617.childFriendlyEnglish: Even when failure seems close, continued effort can create another chance to succeed.
notes_20240423115617.simpleHindiExplanation: हार सामने दिखाई दे तब भी प्रयास न छोड़ने की प्रेरणा दी गई है। लगातार यत्न करने से पराजय को जीत में बदला जा सकता है।
notes_20240423115617.context: Dated 2023-03-18 with “पराभव” as the prompt, this is general motivational advice. No particular contest, examination, battle, or personal setback is named.

literalEnglish: The ruler known as Madan Shah commissioned this distinctive hilltop palace.
See it now in ruined form near Jabalpur.
notes_20240423115621.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem points to Madan Mahal near Jabalpur, remembering its builder while noting that the historic structure now survives in a damaged state.
notes_20240423115621.simpleHindiExplanation: जबलपुर के पास स्थित मदन महल और उसके भग्न वर्तमान रूप का उल्लेख है। रचना इसके निर्माण को मदन शाह से जोड़ती है और पाठक को इस ऐतिहासिक स्थान को देखने का निमंत्रण देती है।
notes_20240423115621.context: The catalog date is 2023-03-19, while the मंच date is 2023-03-20, with “मदन” as the prompt. The poem attributes Madan Mahal to Madan Shah; historical descriptions sometimes vary in how they describe its patron, period, and later use, so the override preserves the source's attribution without adding unsupported detail.

literalEnglish: Forget discrimination and live together in harmony.
Whenever a crisis comes, do not let go of one another's hand.
notes_20240423115625.childFriendlyEnglish: People should set prejudice aside, stay united, and support one another when trouble comes.
notes_20240423115625.simpleHindiExplanation: भेदभाव भूलकर मेल-जोल से रहने और संकट के समय एक-दूसरे का साथ न छोड़ने का संदेश है।
notes_20240423115625.context: The catalog date is 2023-03-20, while the मंच date is 2023-03-21, with “भेदभाव” as the prompt. The type of discrimination is not specified, so the context should not assign it to one particular social division.

literalEnglish: A miser's hoarded wealth is consumed by the devil.
Spend to your heart's content, and live as a happy person.
notes_20240423115638.childFriendlyEnglish: Using comic exaggeration, the poem warns against hoarding every resource and encourages people to enjoy and use their money rather than never benefiting from it.
notes_20240423115638.simpleHindiExplanation: कंजूसी से धन जमा करते रहने पर व्यंग्य किया गया है। भाव यह है कि धन का उचित उपयोग भी होना चाहिए; “जी भर के खर्चा” अतिशयोक्ति है, जिम्मेदारी छोड़ने की शाब्दिक सलाह नहीं।
notes_20240423115638.context: The record is cataloged on 2023-03-20 but gives the much earlier मंच date 2023-01-31, with “कृपण” as the prompt. The devil consuming wealth is proverbial hyperbole, and the second line should not be treated as financial advice to spend without limits.

literalEnglish: Event number: 58.
The year became two thousand eighty, the new Sanatan year.
On Chaitra Shukla Pratipada, joy spreads in every direction.
Joy spreads everywhere, and bright red flags fly.
Navratri has begun; Mother, we seek your refuge.
Meditate upon the Mother and take hold of devotion's rope.
May this Vikram Samvat two thousand eighty be auspicious.
notes_20240423115646.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem welcomes Vikram Samvat 2080 with Chaitra's new year, the beginning of Navratri, red flags, and a prayer for the Divine Mother's blessing.
notes_20240423115646.simpleHindiExplanation: चैत्र शुक्ल प्रतिपदा पर विक्रम संवत 2080 के नववर्ष और नवरात्र आरंभ होने का उत्सव है। लाल ध्वज, माता की शरण और भक्ति की डोर के माध्यम से मंगलकामना की गई है।
notes_20240423115646.context: Dated 2023-03-21 with “नव वर्ष” as the prompt, the कुंडलिया marks Vikram Samvat 2080 and Chaitra Shukla Pratipada. “Sanatan year” reflects the poem's devotional-cultural framing; calendar observances and new-year names vary among regions and communities.

literalEnglish: Waiting for Rama, Shabari sweeps the path.
She has long been calling: when may I lovingly offer him berries?
notes_20240423115652.childFriendlyEnglish: Shabari patiently prepares for Rama's arrival and longs to welcome him with berries offered in love.
notes_20240423115652.simpleHindiExplanation: शबरी राम की प्रतीक्षा में मार्ग साफ करती है और प्रेम से बेर खिलाने की इच्छा रखती है। यह धैर्य, सेवा और निष्कपट भक्ति का दृश्य है।
notes_20240423115652.context: Dated 2023-03-21 with “शबरी” as the prompt, the verse draws on the Ramayana tradition of Shabari awaiting Rama and offering berries. Details about tasting the berries first are not stated here and are therefore not added.

literalEnglish: Pollen.
Bees swagger through the garden, displaying great pride.
When they settle on flowers, they drink the pollen's nectar.
notes_20240423115707.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem playfully imagines proud bees roaming the garden and feeding when they land on flowers.
notes_20240423115707.simpleHindiExplanation: बाग में इठलाते भौंरों का मानवीकरण किया गया है। वे फूलों पर बैठकर पराग या मधुर रस लेते हैं और गर्व से घूमते दिखाई देते हैं।
notes_20240423115707.context: The record is cataloged on 2023-03-21 but gives 2023-03-20 as the मंच date, with “पराग/समानार्थी” as the prompt. “अलि” means a bee or bumblebee; “पराग का पान” poetically blends pollen with the nectar bees drink, so it is not a precise biological description.

literalEnglish: To become like Shabari, keep the mind pure.
Cultivate a feeling of love, wise people say.
notes_20240423115710.childFriendlyEnglish: Shabari is presented as an example of pure-hearted, loving devotion that anyone can try to follow.
notes_20240423115710.simpleHindiExplanation: शबरी जैसी निष्कपट भक्ति के लिए मन की शुद्धता और प्रेमभाव को आवश्यक बताया गया है। रचना उनके चरित्र को आचरण का आदर्श बनाती है।
notes_20240423115710.context: Dated 2023-03-21 with “शबरी” as the prompt, the poem treats Shabari as a devotional model. “Becoming Shabari” is figurative: it means cultivating qualities associated with her, not literally assuming her identity.

literalEnglish: Forget discrimination and live together in harmony.
Whenever hardship comes, never let go of one another's hand.
notes_20240423115714.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem asks people to set differences aside, stay united, and support one another especially when trouble arrives.
notes_20240423115714.simpleHindiExplanation: भेदभाव छोड़कर प्रेम और मेल-जोल से रहने की सीख दी गई है। संकट के समय एक-दूसरे का साथ न छोड़ना सच्ची एकता मानी गई है।
notes_20240423115714.context: Dated 2023-03-21 with “भेदभाव” as the prompt, the couplet gives general social advice about equality and mutual support. It does not identify a particular dispute or community.

literalEnglish: Learn wisdom from honourable great people.
If you follow their path, you will earn respect.
notes_20240423115718.childFriendlyEnglish: Good role models can teach us how to behave with integrity, and following their example may help us become worthy of respect.
notes_20240423115718.simpleHindiExplanation: सज्जन और महान लोगों के जीवन से ज्ञान लेने को कहा गया है। उनके अच्छे आचरण का अनुसरण करने से व्यक्ति सम्मान के योग्य बन सकता है।
notes_20240423115718.context: The catalog date is 2023-03-21, while the raw note gives 2023-03-22 and “भद्र” as the prompt. “Great people” is not tied to any named person, so the advice remains general.

literalEnglish: Observe Martyrs' Day, for Bhagat gave his life.
We feel great pride in Rajguru and Sukhdev.
notes_20240423115722.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem remembers Bhagat Singh, Rajguru, and Sukhdev and honours the courage and sacrifice associated with Martyrs' Day.
notes_20240423115722.simpleHindiExplanation: शहीद दिवस पर भगत सिंह, राजगुरु और सुखदेव के बलिदान को याद करके गर्व व्यक्त किया गया है। इन तीनों स्वतंत्रता सेनानियों को श्रद्धांजलि दी गई है।
notes_20240423115722.context: Dated 2023-03-23 with “शहीद” as the prompt, the wording appears to mark the anniversary of the 1931 execution of Bhagat Singh, Shivaram Rajguru, and Sukhdev Thapar. The shortened “भगत” is read as Bhagat Singh because the other two names occur beside it.

literalEnglish: To attain heaven, ascetics practise yoga.
Heaven and hell are both here, where the results of deeds are experienced.
notes_20240423115729.childFriendlyEnglish: Rather than treating heaven and hell only as distant places, the poem says our actions can create joyful or painful results in this life.
notes_20240423115729.simpleHindiExplanation: योगी स्वर्ग की साधना करते हैं, पर दोहा कहता है कि अच्छे-बुरे कर्मों का फल इसी जीवन में सुख या दुख के रूप में मिलता है। यही धरती स्वर्ग या नरक जैसी लग सकती है।
notes_20240423115729.context: Dated 2023-03-25 with “नरक” as the prompt, the verse combines religious imagery with a moral claim about experiencing consequences in the present world. It does not define a single theological doctrine.

literalEnglish: Without the living spirit, this body is worth no more than clay.
One day it will perish; listen with your ears open.
notes_20240423115735.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem uses the image of clay to remind us that the body does not last forever and that life should not be taken for granted.
notes_20240423115735.simpleHindiExplanation: जीव या प्राण के बिना शरीर को मिट्टी के समान बताया गया है। शरीर नश्वर है, इसलिए इस सच्चाई को ध्यान से समझने की चेतावनी दी गई है।
notes_20240423115735.context: Dated 2023-03-25 with “जीव” as the prompt, the couplet reflects on mortality. Whether “जीव” means soul, life-force, or simply a living being is not specified, so “living spirit” is a cautious rendering.

literalEnglish: When dense black clouds spread across the sky,
the delighted peacocks sway and dance.
notes_20240423115740.childFriendlyEnglish: Dark rain clouds fill the sky, and the happy peacocks begin dancing as if welcoming the coming rain.
notes_20240423115740.simpleHindiExplanation: घने काले बादल छाने पर मोर प्रसन्न होकर झूमते और नाचते हैं। वर्षा के आगमन का उल्लास प्रकृति के इस दृश्य में दिखाया गया है।
notes_20240423115740.context: Dated 2023-03-26 with “नृत्य” as the prompt, the poem uses the familiar seasonal image of peacocks dancing beneath rain clouds. No particular place or observed storm is identified.

literalEnglish: Water remains pure in an earthen pot.
Filled with nutrients, it is drunk by discerning people.
notes_20240423115744.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem praises drinking water stored in a clay pot, which traditionally keeps water cool, while its stronger health claim still needs evidence.
notes_20240423115744.simpleHindiExplanation: मिट्टी के घड़े में रखा पानी शुद्ध और उपयोगी माना गया है। घड़ा पानी ठंडा रख सकता है, लेकिन “पोषक तत्त्वों से भरा” होने का दावा कविता का है, चिकित्सकीय रूप से यहाँ सिद्ध नहीं किया गया।
notes_20240423115744.context: Dated 2023-03-26 with “कुंभ” as the prompt, “कुंभ” means an earthen water pot here. The statement about nutrients is preserved as the poem's claim and should not be treated as verified medical guidance.

literalEnglish: Event number: 59
On sacred Chaitra Navami, Rama took birth in divine form.
Kaushalya rejoiced on seeing the wondrous child.
Seeing that wondrous form, congratulations rang through Ayodhya.
The gods came to Ayodhya, assuming many forms, dear one.
Everyone found the child Rama's appearance delightful.
Chaitra Navami thus became a peerless and sacred date.
notes_20240423115748.childFriendlyEnglish: This kundaliya celebrates Rama's birth on Chaitra Navami, imagining Kaushalya's joy and all Ayodhya welcoming the beautiful child with festivities.
notes_20240423115748.simpleHindiExplanation: कुंडलिया राम जन्म की पौराणिक कथा का उत्सव मनाती है। चैत्र नवमी पर बाल राम को देखकर कौशल्या प्रसन्न होती हैं, अयोध्या में बधाइयाँ बजती हैं और देवताओं के आने की कल्पना की गई है।
notes_20240423115748.context: The record is dated 2023-03-26, labels itself event 59, and gives “नवमी” as the prompt. The poem recounts devotional Ram Navami tradition; “the gods came in many forms” belongs to that sacred narrative and is not historical reporting.

literalEnglish: Only after washing the Lord's feet did he ferry him across.
Before the boatman Kevat's insistence, the Lord accepted defeat.
notes_20240423115752.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem recalls the boatman Kevat lovingly insisting on washing Rama's feet before carrying him across the river, and Rama kindly yielding to his devotion.
notes_20240423115752.simpleHindiExplanation: रामकथा के केवट प्रसंग में केवट पहले प्रभु के चरण धोने पर अड़ता है और फिर नाव से पार कराता है। “हार मानना” यहाँ भक्त के प्रेमपूर्ण हठ को स्वीकार करना है।
notes_20240423115752.context: Dated 2023-03-27 with “हठ” as the prompt, the verse refers to the devotional Kevat episode from Rama traditions. Versions differ in details, so the context is limited to what the two lines clearly evoke.

literalEnglish: Students are left without answers because the questions seem difficult.
They create an uproar while demanding that the question paper be examined.
notes_20240423115756.childFriendlyEnglish: When an exam paper feels unusually hard, students may be unable to answer and ask officials to review whether the questions were fair.
notes_20240423115756.simpleHindiExplanation: कठिन प्रश्नों से छात्र उत्तर नहीं दे पा रहे हैं और प्रश्नपत्र की जाँच की माँग कर रहे हैं। “बवाल” उनके विरोध या हंगामे को दर्शाता है, पर परीक्षा कौन-सी थी यह नहीं बताया गया।
notes_20240423115756.context: Dated 2023-03-27 with “निरुत्तर” as the prompt, the couplet appears to describe complaints about a difficult examination paper. No exam board, subject, or incident is named, so a specific controversy cannot be confirmed.

literalEnglish: Become intoxicated with devotion, so that a path to liberation may form.
By divine grace, one may receive happiness and prosperity.
notes_20240423115759.childFriendlyEnglish: Using “intoxication” as a positive metaphor, the poem encourages deep devotion and expresses hope for spiritual freedom and divine blessings.
notes_20240423115759.simpleHindiExplanation: यहाँ “नशा” वास्तविक नशीले पदार्थ का नहीं, भक्ति में पूरी तरह डूबने का रूपक है। ऐसी भक्ति से मुक्ति, सुख और समृद्धि मिलने की धार्मिक आशा व्यक्त की गई है।
notes_20240423115759.context: Dated 2023-03-28 with “नशा” as the prompt, the poem deliberately recasts intoxication as devotional absorption. Its promises of liberation and prosperity are statements of faith, not guaranteed outcomes.

literalEnglish: Bees drink nectar and produce honey.
In treating illnesses, honey saves lives.
notes_20240423115806.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem connects flower nectar, bees, and honey, then praises honey's traditional use in care for illness, though it should not replace proper medical treatment.
notes_20240423115806.simpleHindiExplanation: मधुमक्खियाँ फूलों से मकरंद लेकर शहद बनाती हैं। दूसरी पंक्ति शहद के औषधीय उपयोग की प्रशंसा करती है, लेकिन “प्राण बचाना” काव्यात्मक दावा है और चिकित्सा का विकल्प नहीं।
notes_20240423115806.context: The catalog date is 2023-03-28, while the raw prompt metadata says 2023-02-28 and gives “मकरंद/पराग.” The biological link between nectar and honey is clear; the life-saving medical claim is broad and unsupported in the note.

literalEnglish: Spreading a star-filled veil, the sky speaks:
Earth, please accept the love in my heart.
notes_20240423115809.childFriendlyEnglish: The sky offers the earth a sparkling veil of stars, turning the meeting of sky and land into a gentle conversation of love.
notes_20240423115809.simpleHindiExplanation: व्योम और धरती का मानवीकरण किया गया है। तारों भरी चुनरी फैलाकर आकाश धरती से अपने प्रेम को स्वीकार करने की विनती करता है।
notes_20240423115809.context: Dated 2023-03-29 with “व्योम” as the prompt, the couplet personifies the sky and earth as loving speakers. It is imaginative nature poetry, not evidence of a specific relationship or event.

literalEnglish: Today a woman is flying a fighter jet.
Avani Chaturvedi has become a symbol of India.
notes_20240423115813.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem celebrates women flying fighter aircraft and names Avani Chaturvedi as an inspiring Indian pioneer.
notes_20240423115813.simpleHindiExplanation: महिलाओं के लड़ाकू विमान उड़ाने की उपलब्धि पर गर्व व्यक्त किया गया है। अवनी चतुर्वेदी को इस प्रगति और भारत की पहचान से जोड़ा गया है।
notes_20240423115813.context: Dated 2023-03-29 with “महिला” as the prompt, the verse names Indian Air Force pilot Avani Chaturvedi, one of India's first women commissioned as fighter pilots. The line does not specify which flight or milestone prompted it.

literalEnglish: Lord Rama
Hanuman, son of the wind, went to search for Sita.
He helped Lord Rama and is a great devotee.
notes_20240423115817.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem praises Hanuman for searching for Sita, helping Rama, and showing steadfast devotion through action.
notes_20240423115817.simpleHindiExplanation: रामकथा में हनुमान सीता की खोज के लिए जाते हैं और राम की सहायता करते हैं। उनके इस कार्य को महान भक्ति और सेवा का उदाहरण बताया गया है।
notes_20240423115817.context: Dated 2023-03-30 with a prompt offering names for Rama and Ram Navami, the verse recalls Hanuman's search for Sita in the Ramayana tradition. It does not retell the surrounding episodes in detail.

literalEnglish: With the help of his devotees, the Lord crossed the ocean.
A bridge was built upon the sea, witnessed by the world.
notes_20240423115832.childFriendlyEnglish: Rama's followers work together to build the bridge to Lanka, showing how loyal helpers can make an enormous task possible.
notes_20240423115832.simpleHindiExplanation: रामकथा के समुद्र-सेतु प्रसंग में भक्तों और वानर सेना की सहायता से राम समुद्र पार करते हैं। पुल बनना सामूहिक सहयोग और भक्ति की शक्ति का चित्र है।
notes_20240423115832.context: Dated 2023-03-30 with “मदद” as the prompt, the couplet appears to refer to the Ramayana's bridge to Lanka. “The world witnessed” is poetic emphasis, not a documented eyewitness claim.

literalEnglish: When Venus rises, auspicious activities take place.
If Venus is favourable in a marriage chart, pleasant results are expected.
notes_20240423115836.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem reflects an astrological belief that a favourable Venus is a good sign for ceremonies and marriage.
notes_20240423115836.simpleHindiExplanation: ज्योतिषीय मान्यता के अनुसार शुक्र के उदय और विवाह-कुंडली में उसकी शुभ स्थिति को अच्छे परिणामों से जोड़ा गया है। इसे सांस्कृतिक विश्वास समझना चाहिए, निश्चित भविष्यवाणी नहीं।
notes_20240423115836.context: Dated 2023-03-30, the note has no clearly preserved prompt line. The wording uses Hindu astrological ideas about Venus and marriage charts; these are beliefs expressed by the poem rather than scientifically established predictions.

literalEnglish: By worrying about the next world, a person may spoil both worlds.
One who lives in the present will not grieve tomorrow.
notes_20240423115840.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem advises us not to become so anxious about an afterlife that we neglect today; living attentively now can reduce future regret.
notes_20240423115840.simpleHindiExplanation: परलोक की चिंता में वर्तमान जीवन बिगाड़ने से सावधान किया गया है। आज को समझदारी से जीने पर कल पछतावा कम हो सकता है।
notes_20240423115840.context: Dated 2023-03-31 with “लोक” as the prompt, the couplet contrasts concern for the afterlife with mindful present living. It offers moral advice rather than rejecting or proving any religious belief.

literalEnglish: You have received a human life, so repeat the Divine name.
Then life's final time may pass peacefully, without regret.
notes_20240423115844.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem encourages using human life for prayer and good reflection so that one may face the end of life with peace rather than remorse.
notes_20240423115844.simpleHindiExplanation: मानव जीवन को मूल्यवान मानकर प्रभु-स्मरण करने की सलाह दी गई है। ऐसा जीवन अंत समय में शांति और कम पछतावा देने वाला माना गया है।
notes_20240423115844.context: Dated 2023-04-01 with “पश्चाताप” as the prompt, the verse expresses a devotional view of preparing for death through remembrance of God. The peaceful outcome is a hope of faith, not a guarantee.

literalEnglish: A successful student is one who keeps attention on the goal.
Such a student lives with discipline and respects the teacher.
notes_20240423115849.childFriendlyEnglish: Focus, a steady routine, and respect for teachers are presented as habits that help a student learn and succeed.
notes_20240423115849.simpleHindiExplanation: सफल विद्यार्थी के लिए लक्ष्य पर ध्यान, अनुशासित जीवन और गुरु का सम्मान आवश्यक गुण बताए गए हैं। सफलता को केवल अंक नहीं, अच्छे आचरण से भी जोड़ा गया है।
notes_20240423115849.context: The catalog date is 2023-04-01, while the raw metadata gives 2023-03-31 and “छात्र” as the prompt. The advice is general and does not refer to a named school or examination.

literalEnglish: Theme: free choice, “student”
A talented student strives like a crow.
With a heron's concentration, the student fixes attention on the goal.
Sleeping like a dog, the student always appears alert.
Eating lightly, the student keeps the body agile.
Respectfully submitted for review.
notes_20240423115856.childFriendlyEnglish: Using a traditional set of animal comparisons, the poem describes an ideal student as persistent, deeply focused, lightly sleeping, alert, and moderate in eating.
notes_20240423115856.simpleHindiExplanation: रोला में आदर्श विद्यार्थी के गुण पशु-पक्षियों की उपमाओं से बताए गए हैं—कौए जैसा प्रयास, बगुले जैसा ध्यान, कुत्ते जैसी सजग नींद और कम भोजन। ये पारंपरिक आदर्श हैं, हर बच्चे के लिए कठोर नियम नहीं।
notes_20240423115856.context: Dated 2023-04-01 and marked as a free-choice poem on “छात्र,” the lines echo the traditional student maxim about the crow, crane, dog, light eating, and leaving home. This version uses only some of those traits.

literalEnglish: Sustainer of the world, Mother Queen, please show grace.
I keep calling to you; listen, Mother Bhavani.
Remove sorrow and grant happiness, benevolent Mother.
Your glory is boundless; how much of it can I describe?
Respectfully submitted for review.
notes_20240423115927.childFriendlyEnglish: The speaker prays to the goddess Bhavani as a caring mother, asking her to hear the call, ease sorrow, and bring comfort.
notes_20240423115927.simpleHindiExplanation: माँ भवानी को जगत की पालनहार मानकर कृपा की प्रार्थना की गई है। भक्त दुख दूर करने और सुख देने की विनती करता है तथा देवी की महिमा को अनंत बताता है।
notes_20240423115927.context: The catalog date is 2023-04-01, while the raw note gives 2023-03-25 and no separate prompt. “Bhavani,” “Mother,” and “Kalyani” indicate a devotional address to the goddess; no particular temple or occasion is named.

literalEnglish: Satyabhama was astonished while arranging a balance-offering for the Lord.
A sacred basil leaf was offered, and Krishna preserved her honour.
notes_20240423115931.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem recalls a devotional story in which wealth cannot balance Krishna, but a sincerely offered tulsi leaf succeeds, teaching that loving faith matters more than riches.
notes_20240423115931.simpleHindiExplanation: यह कृष्ण, सत्यभामा और तुलसी-दल से जुड़ी तुलाभार कथा का संकेत है। बहुत-सा धन पर्याप्त नहीं होता, पर श्रद्धा से रखा तुलसी-पत्ता सफल होता है; अलग कथाओं में प्रसंग के विवरण बदल सकते हैं।
notes_20240423115931.context: Dated 2023-04-01 with “अर्पण” as the prompt, the couplet appears to invoke the Krishna Tulabharam legend involving Satyabhama and a tulsi leaf. The poem does not name Rukmini, who appears in common versions, so that detail is not added to the translation.

literalEnglish: They offered body, mind, and wealth to every task of the nation.
Today we are grateful for the sacrifices of those heroes.
notes_20240423115937.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem thanks national heroes who devoted their strength, thoughts, resources, and lives to serving the country.
notes_20240423115937.simpleHindiExplanation: देश के कार्यों के लिए तन, मन और धन समर्पित करने वाले वीरों के बलिदान के प्रति कृतज्ञता व्यक्त की गई है। किसी एक वीर या घटना का नाम नहीं दिया गया।
notes_20240423115937.context: Dated 2023-04-01 with “अर्पण” as the prompt, the couplet offers patriotic gratitude to unnamed heroes. The date and wording do not securely identify a specific commemoration or conflict.

literalEnglish: I offer bilva leaves in Shiva's court.
Within my heart I bow; Lord, please accept my prayer.
notes_20240423115942.childFriendlyEnglish: The speaker offers sacred bilva leaves to Shiva and quietly prays that this sincere act of devotion will be accepted.
notes_20240423115942.simpleHindiExplanation: शिवजी को बेलपत्र चढ़ाकर मन ही मन प्रणाम किया गया है। भक्त अपने भाव और अर्पण को प्रभु से स्वीकार करने की विनती करता है।
notes_20240423115942.context: Dated 2023-04-01 with “अर्पण” as the prompt, the poem refers to the Hindu practice of offering bilva leaves to Shiva. No festival, temple, or personal ceremony is specified.

literalEnglish: The young women walk to the waterside while Gopal waits along the path.
He catches an arm and teases them, creating lively commotion.
notes_20240423115946.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem draws on playful Krishna folklore at the village waterside, where Gopal mischievously stops and teases the milkmaids.
notes_20240423115946.simpleHindiExplanation: पनघट जाती सखियों और राह देखते गोपाल का कृष्ण-लीला जैसा दृश्य है। बाँह पकड़कर छेड़ना पारंपरिक काव्य में चंचलता के रूप में आया है, पर आधुनिक जीवन में सहमति और सम्मान आवश्यक हैं।
notes_20240423115946.context: Dated 2023-04-02 with “पनघट” as the prompt, “Gopal” and the waterside companions strongly suggest Krishna pastoral imagery. The physical teasing is translated as written without presenting it as acceptable real-world conduct.

literalEnglish: Event number: 60
Bajirao was great and never lost a war.
Wise people should learn the history of India.
Let people learn it: foreign powers trembled before him.
Skilled in weaponry, he gauged his targets remarkably well.
Foreign forces were defeated, and the Nizam suffered a crushing loss.
Bajirao appears as a destroyer of enemies and an embodiment of strength.

notes_20240423115950.simpleHindiExplanation: कुंडलिया पेशवा बाजीराव प्रथम की वीरता, युद्ध-कौशल और निजाम पर विजय की प्रशंसा करती है। “कभी न हारे” और शत्रुओं के काँपने जैसे कथन वीर-रस की भाषा हैं; विस्तृत ऐतिहासिक सत्यापन अलग से चाहिए।
notes_20240423115950.context: Dated 2023-04-02, labelled event 60, and prompted by “बाजीराव,” the poem most likely refers to Peshwa Bajirao I because it mentions the Nizam and an undefeated reputation. “Foreign powers” is broad wording, and the exact campaigns intended are not listed.

literalEnglish: Work
Whenever I begin a task, I first bow to Lord Ganesha.
Remove all my obstacles and cut away every affliction.
notes_20240423115955.childFriendlyEnglish: Before beginning work, the speaker prays to Ganesha for help in overcoming obstacles and difficulties.
notes_20240423115955.simpleHindiExplanation: हर कार्य के आरंभ में श्री गणेश को प्रणाम करके विघ्न और कष्ट दूर करने की प्रार्थना की गई है। शीर्षक “कार्य” है, जबकि संरक्षित मंच-शब्द “करतब” दर्ज है।
notes_20240423115955.context: Dated 2023-04-04, the raw note titles the piece “कार्य” but records “करतब” as the provided prompt. The verse follows the devotional custom of invoking Ganesha before beginning a task; the mismatch is preserved rather than resolved.

literalEnglish: Chittor's fort stands as a source of India's pride.
The stories of many great heroes are connected with it.
notes_20240423115958.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem honours Chittorgarh Fort as a proud historic place remembered through many stories of courage.
notes_20240423115958.simpleHindiExplanation: चित्तौड़ के दुर्ग को भारत का गौरव बताया गया है। उससे जुड़ी अनेक वीरगाथाओं और ऐतिहासिक व्यक्तियों की स्मृति का सम्मान किया गया है।
notes_20240423115958.context: Dated 2023-04-04 with “दुर्ग” as the prompt, the verse clearly points to Chittorgarh Fort. It does not name particular rulers, battles, or legends, so none are singled out here.

literalEnglish: From Mahavira came the teaching of truth and nonviolence.
Celebrating his birth anniversary, the whole world rejoices.
notes_20240423120002.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem celebrates Mahavira Jayanti and remembers Mahavira's teachings of truth and nonviolence.
notes_20240423120002.simpleHindiExplanation: महावीर जयंती पर भगवान महावीर से मिली सत्य और अहिंसा की शिक्षा को याद किया गया है। उत्सव की खुशी को पूरे संसार के झूमने की अतिशयोक्ति से व्यक्त किया गया है।
notes_20240423120002.context: Dated 2023-04-05 with “जयंती” as the prompt, the wording identifies Mahavira Jayanti. “The whole world” is celebratory poetic language and does not claim universal observance.

literalEnglish: The full-moon date of bright Chaitra is greatly revered.
On this date Hanuman, son of the wind, is believed to have appeared.
notes_20240423120007.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem marks Hanuman's birth celebration on the full moon of Chaitra and honours him as the son of the wind-god.
notes_20240423120007.simpleHindiExplanation: चैत्र शुक्ल पूर्णिमा को हनुमान जन्मोत्सव की पावन तिथि बताया गया है। हनुमान को पवनपुत्र कहकर उनके प्रकट होने की धार्मिक परंपरा याद की गई है।
notes_20240423120007.context: The catalog date is 2023-04-05, while the raw metadata gives 2023-04-06 and “हनुमान” as the prompt. The verse states a common North Indian Hanuman Jayanti tradition; observance dates can differ by region.

literalEnglish: The Lord's name emerges with every beat of Hanuman's heart.
Within his heart dwell Lord Rama together with Sita.
notes_20240423120011.childFriendlyEnglish: Hanuman's heartbeat is imagined as continually speaking Rama's name because Rama and Sita live in his heart through complete devotion.
notes_20240423120011.simpleHindiExplanation: हनुमान की हर धड़कन में प्रभु का नाम सुनाई देने की भक्तिपूर्ण कल्पना है। उनके हृदय में सीता और राम के बसने का अर्थ उनकी अटूट भक्ति है।
notes_20240423120011.context: Dated 2023-04-06 with “उर” (heart) as the prompt, the couplet uses familiar devotional imagery of Sita and Rama dwelling in Hanuman's heart. It is spiritual symbolism, not an anatomical claim.

literalEnglish: Hanuman
He remains devoted to Rama, with no other task.
Worship Hanuman, and troubled affairs will be set right.
Lucknow
notes_20240423120014.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem praises Hanuman's single-minded devotion to Rama and expresses faith that praying to Hanuman can bring help in difficult situations.
notes_20240423120014.simpleHindiExplanation: हनुमान का मुख्य कार्य राम-भक्ति बताया गया है। उनकी पूजा से बिगड़े काम सँवरने की आशा व्यक्त होती है; यह भक्तिपूर्ण विश्वास है, निश्चित परिणाम का वादा नहीं।
notes_20240423120014.context: Dated 2023-04-06 with a prompt listing names for Hanuman, the record also preserves “Lucknow” as a location line. The claim about fixing difficulties is devotional language rather than practical assurance.

literalEnglish: The Balakot operation gave India recognition across the world.
Imran was stunned by the air force's strike.
notes_20240423120018.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem expresses national pride in the Balakot airstrike and portrays Pakistan's leader as shocked by the Indian Air Force action.
notes_20240423120018.simpleHindiExplanation: यह दोहा बालाकोट वायु हमले को भारत की वैश्विक पहचान और सैन्य शक्ति से जोड़ता है। “इमरान” संभवतः तत्कालीन पाकिस्तानी प्रधानमंत्री इमरान खान हैं, पर उनकी निजी प्रतिक्रिया कविता का दावा है।
notes_20240423120018.context: The catalog date is 2023-04-06, while the raw metadata gives 2023-04-07 and “मोर्चा” as the prompt. The wording appears to refer to India's 2019 Balakot airstrike and likely names then Pakistani prime minister Imran Khan; “stunned” is rhetorical and not independently evidenced here.

literalEnglish: Forgiveness
By always granting forgiveness, become generous and noble.
Goodwill grows, and honour and respect increase.
Lucknow
notes_20240423120022.childFriendlyEnglish: Forgiving others can reduce bitterness, strengthen goodwill, and help a person act with generosity and dignity.
notes_20240423120022.simpleHindiExplanation: क्षमा करने से मन की उदारता और आपसी सद्भाव बढ़ता है। इससे संबंध सुधर सकते हैं और व्यक्ति का सम्मान भी बढ़ता है।
notes_20240423120022.context: Dated 2023-04-07 with a prompt listing forgiveness and its synonyms, the record also preserves “Lucknow” as a location line. The couplet offers general ethical advice, not a response to a named offence.

literalEnglish: The city of Kashi is revered as the abode of Vishwanath.
Its name has spread far and wide across the world.
notes_20240423120027.childFriendlyEnglish: The poem honours Kashi as the sacred home of Vishwanath and celebrates its wide religious fame.
notes_20240423120027.simpleHindiExplanation: काशी को पूजनीय नगरी और विश्वनाथ का धाम बताया गया है। उसकी धार्मिक प्रसिद्धि को दूर-दूर तक फैला हुआ कहा गया है।
notes_20240423120027.context: Dated 2023-04-07 with “नगरी” as the prompt, the verse refers to Kashi, or Varanasi, and the Kashi Vishwanath tradition. No particular pilgrimage or event is named.

literalEnglish: Clouds covered the sky, and delighted peacocks danced.
The easterly breeze began to blow, spreading exhilaration.
notes_20240423120034.childFriendlyEnglish: Clouds, dancing peacocks, and a fresh east wind together create the joyful feeling of rain approaching.
notes_20240423120034.simpleHindiExplanation: आकाश में बादल छाने, मोरों के नाचने और पुरवाई चलने से वर्षा ऋतु का आनंदमय वातावरण बनता है। “सुरूर” यहाँ प्रकृति से उपजा उल्लास है।
notes_20240423120034.context: Dated 2023-04-08 with “मयूर” as the prompt, the couplet presents a seasonal nature scene. It does not identify a particular storm, monsoon date, or location.

literalEnglish: Ganesha, treasury of wisdom, please accept this invitation.
Lord, bring Riddhi and Siddhi with you.
notes_20240423120038.childFriendlyEnglish: The speaker warmly invites Ganesha, asking the wise deity to arrive together with the blessings represented by Riddhi and Siddhi.
notes_20240423120038.simpleHindiExplanation: ज्ञान के भंडार गणपति को आमंत्रित किया गया है और उनसे रिद्धि-सिद्धि को साथ लाने की विनती है। ये नाम समृद्धि और आध्यात्मिक सिद्धि के प्रतीक भी माने जाते हैं।
notes_20240423120038.context: The catalog date is 2023-04-08, while the raw metadata gives 2023-04-09 and “आमंत्रण” as the prompt. The verse uses devotional Ganesha imagery; it does not specify a wedding, worship ceremony, or other occasion for the invitation.

literalEnglish: Lower the rope of devotion into the well of devotion to Rama.
Fill your pitcher with the water of happiness and draw it toward yourself.
notes_20240423120041.childFriendlyEnglish: Faith is pictured as drawing refreshing water from a well: devotion is both the rope and the source from which the heart gathers joy.
notes_20240423120041.simpleHindiExplanation: राम-भक्ति को कुएँ और भक्ति को रस्सी मानकर रूपक बनाया गया है। साधक उस कुएँ से सुखरूपी जल भरकर अपने जीवन में लाता है।
notes_20240423120041.context: Dated 2023-04-09 with “कूप” as the prompt, the poem develops an extended well-and-water metaphor for devotion to Rama. It describes spiritual happiness, not a physical well.

notes_20240423120048.simpleHindiExplanation: स्वतंत्र विषय के रोला में बादल, नाचते मोर, पुरवाई, झूमते पेड़ और अमराई का वर्षा-दृश्य है। जीव-जंतुओं और धरती को भी प्रसन्न दिखाकर पूरी प्रकृति का उल्लास रचा गया है।

notes_20240423120228.context: The catalog date is 2023-04-12, while the raw metadata gives 2023-04-13 and “अटपटा” as the prompt. The scene is a general family moment; no particular mother or child is identified.

notes_20240423120233.context: Dated 2023-04-13 with “संध्या” as the prompt, the couplet preserves customary beliefs about evening conduct and Lakshmi. It should be read as cultural-religious advice, not as a demonstrable cause of prosperity.

notes_20240423120241.simpleHindiExplanation: सुबह उठकर सैर और व्यायाम करने की स्वास्थ्यकर सलाह दी गई है। रोग-दुख पूरी तरह दूर होने और वैद्य की जरूरत न पड़ने की बात काव्यात्मक अतिशयोक्ति है, चिकित्सकीय गारंटी नहीं।

notes_20240423120245.simpleHindiExplanation: श्रीराम राजमहल और अयोध्या का सुख छोड़कर पिता के वचन का सम्मान करते हुए वन जाते हैं। दोहा वचन-पालन और त्याग को महत्व देता है।
notes_20240423120245.context: The record is dated 2023-04-15 and names “भवन” as the provided word. It draws on the Ramayana episode of Rama leaving Ayodhya for exile; the verse does not specify a particular retelling.

notes_20240423120249.simpleHindiExplanation: दोहा एक प्रभावशाली अपराधी को अपने अत्यधिक अपराधों के परिणाम पर असहाय होकर पछताते दिखाता है। संदेश है कि गलत शक्ति अंत में सहारा नहीं देती।
notes_20240423120249.context: Dated 2023-04-15 with the prompt “गुनाह,” the verse appears to respond to then-current news about a mafia figure facing loss or punishment. No person is named, so a specific identification remains uncertain.

The one who committed the crime has received the punishment.
